key_idea: Measure the hole in small squares and use exactly 3 pieces.
steps: The white hole is as long as 3 small squares.
A, B and D are each 1 small square. C is as long as 2 small squares.
A, B and D together make 3 squares, and that is exactly 3 pieces. They fill the hole.
If C were used, only 1 more square would fit. That is 2 pieces, not 3. So C is left over.

choice_feedback.A: A is needed, together with B and D, to make 3 pieces.
choice_feedback.B: B is needed, together with A and D, to make 3 pieces.
choice_feedback.D: D is needed, together with A and B, to make 3 pieces.
choice_feedback.E: A and B are both needed. Only C is left over.
